White Oaks Connect — Aftercare App
Technical Overview & Cost Estimate

What is White Oaks Connect?

White Oaks Connect is a dedicated mobile app for your residents to stay connected and supported after completing their treatment programme.

Think of it as a digital support network that fits in their pocket. After leaving White Oaks, residents often feel isolated and vulnerable — this app gives them a lifeline back to their recovery community and tools to maintain their progress.

What you and your team would see: A simple web dashboard showing who's checking in regularly, who might be struggling (without invading privacy), and trends across your aftercare community. It's like having a gentle pulse on how your graduates are doing without being intrusive.

Why it matters: Recovery doesn't end at discharge. This app extends your care and support beyond the 30-day programme, helping prevent relapse and keeping people connected to their recovery journey — which ultimately reflects well on White Oaks' long-term success rates.

See the App in Action
Resident view: Daily check-ins and community support in their pocket
Staff view: Comprehensive handover tracking and management system
Core Features
  • Daily Check-ins — Simple wellness tracking with mood, sleep, and stress levels
  • Community Support — Peer-to-peer encouragement and shared experiences
  • Progress Tracking — Visual charts showing recovery milestones and achievements
  • Emergency Support — Direct link to crisis helplines and White Oaks support
  • Appointment Reminders — Follow-up session scheduling and notifications
  • Educational Content — Recovery resources and coping strategies
  • Staff Dashboard — Overview of residents' wellbeing without compromising privacy
Technical Specification
  • Platform: Progressive Web App (works on iOS, Android, and desktop)
  • Backend: Node.js with secure cloud database
  • Security: End-to-end encryption, GDPR compliant
  • Integration: Compatible with existing White Oaks systems
  • Analytics: Anonymised reporting and trend analysis
  • Hosting: Secure cloud infrastructure with 99.9% uptime
Investment Breakdown

App Development: £750

Consultancy (Phil Patterson's time): £250

Total Investment: £1,000

Includes full development, testing, deployment, and 3 months ongoing support and maintenance.

Implementation Timeline
  • Week 1-2: Requirements gathering and design finalisation
  • Week 3-4: Core app development and testing
  • Week 5: Staff dashboard and admin panel completion
  • Week 6: Integration testing and deployment preparation
  • Week 7: Beta testing with selected residents and staff
  • Week 8: Final adjustments and full launch
